_documentation.well_known_criterion: Famous firsts in popular knowledge (moon landing, light bulb).
_documentation.obscure_criterion: Less-cited firsts or specific historical dates outside common recall.

well_known.question_text: Who was the first person to walk on the Moon?
In what year did the Wright brothers achieve the first powered flight?
Who is credited with inventing the telephone, with a patent granted in 1876?
In what year was the World Wide Web invented by Tim Berners-Lee at CERN?
Who painted the ceiling of the Sistine Chapel?
Which company released the first iPhone, in 2007?
Who was the first European to lead an expedition that circumnavigated the globe (completed after his death in 1521)?

obscure.question_text: Who was the second person to walk on the Moon?
Who was the first woman to fly solo across the Atlantic Ocean?
Who patented the first practical incandescent light bulb in 1879?
In what year was the first ascent of Mount Everest by Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay?
Who was the first woman in space, in 1963?
Which 1957 satellite was the first artificial object to orbit Earth?
Who was the first European to reach the southern tip of Africa, in 1488?
Who developed the first effective polio vaccine, announced in 1955?
Which expedition was the first to reach the South Pole, in December 1911?
Who was the first woman to win a Nobel Prize, in 1903?
In what year was the first organ transplant (a kidney between identical twins) successfully performed?

post_cutoff.question_text: Which spacecraft, launched in 2024, made the first successful catch of a returning rocket booster?
Which two private astronauts performed the first commercial spacewalk in September 2024 during the Polaris Dawn mission?
In what month and year was the first US presidential election won by Donald Trump in his second non-consecutive term?
Which company achieved the first commercial robotaxi service rollout to the public in San Francisco, with notable expansion in 2024?
